description: Dynamic variables for the Recruitment Proposal document. Pass these in proposalData (or API project-proposal response) to drive all yellow-highlighted / dynamic fields in ProposalModal.

proposalData.date: ISO date string, e.g. 2026-01-28T00:00:00Z → displayed as 'January 28th, 2026'

client.company_name: Client company name, e.g. 'SAS HOLDINGS GLOBAL'
client.contact_person_name: Full name for signature block, e.g. 'Syed Arsam Shah'
client.salutation_name: Optional. Name in salutation only, e.g. 'Arsam' for 'Dear Arsam,' (falls back to contact_person_first_name then contact_person_name)
client.contact_person_first_name: Optional. Used as salutation name when salutation_name not set

pricing.discounted_service_charges_text: Optional. If omitted, derived as '{currency} {contract_price} for one Resource.' or '... for N Resources.'

jobs.job_title: Position name, e.g. 'Cleaning Supervisor - Airbnb apartments'
jobs.min_salary: Optional; used to build salary_range if salary_range not set
jobs.max_salary: Optional; used to build salary_range if salary_range not set

summary.total_salary_range: Optional; e.g. 'PKR 45,000 – 65,000' (total row in scope table)

service_terms.turnaround_text: e.g. '10-12 working days' (proposal doc); API key: turnaround_time

apiPayloadKeys.proposal_date: ISO date string for proposal date
